headline: Executive order directs a review of US foreign aid programs to decide whether they should be changed or realigned.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order calls for the federal government to reevaluate the aid the United States gives to other countries. It also points toward realigning that aid, meaning programs could be changed, kept, or ended after the review. No official summary was provided, so specific steps, deadlines, and agencies involved are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that run foreign aid programs
who_it_affects.how: They would likely be involved in reviewing and possibly changing their aid programs.

who_it_affects.group: Groups and contractors that receive US foreign aid funding
who_it_affects.how: Their funding could be affected depending on the results of the review.

who_it_affects.group: People in other countries served by US aid programs
who_it_affects.how: Services they receive could change if programs are realigned.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 20, 2025; executive orders generally take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
